name: Optocouplers
summary: Small chips that pass a signal across an isolation gap using light, in power supplies and controllers.
uses: Safely linking a microcontroller to mains-side circuits
identify: 4 or 6-pin white or black chips marked PC817, EL817, MOC3021 or 4N35, usually straddling the gap between the mains and low-voltage sides of a power supply.
test: Diode mode across the input pins shows the LED (about 1.1–1.2V). Light the LED through a resistor and check the output pins conduct.
